title: Common Elements
statement:
Find the values that appear in both of two lists of whole numbers.

The input is two lines, each holding one or more integers separated by spaces. Print every value that appears in both lines, each one only once even when it repeats, sorted from smallest to largest as numbers and separated by single spaces. When the lines share no value, print `none`.

Input:

```text
1 2 3 4 5
4 5 6 7
```

Expected output:

```text
4 5
```
hints: Turn each line into a set so repeated values collapse into one.
A value is common when the set from the other line contains it. Sort what you collect before you return it.
